scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run e2e:db -w apps/api && npm run e2e -w apps/web
